criteria.name: Data Understanding & Quality Checks
criteria.guidance: Inspect patient attributes, status labels and lookup tables; verify IDs, target mapping, missing values, duplicates and data quality.

criteria.name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
criteria.guidance: Analyze class balance and clinical-feature distributions; use appropriate plots and avoid unsupported medical interpretation.

criteria.name: Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
criteria.guidance: Handle missing values, data types, outliers and categorical features transparently; exclude identifiers and prevent leakage.

criteria.name: Logistic Regression Baseline
criteria.guidance: Build a reproducible baseline classifier with stratified splitting and train-only preprocessing.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Report confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1 and ROC-AUC where valid; discuss false negatives and educational-use limitations.
